access_evidence: probe ctis_search_blocked: /ctis-public-api/search -> HTTP 403 with the 42-byte body {"message":"Missing Authentication Token"}; the same 403 with a dummy X-API-KEY header; probe ctis_retrieve_empty: /retrieve/<CT number> -> HTTP 200 with a 2-byte {} body; probe ctis_api_docs_is_spa_shell: /api-docs -> HTTP 200 with the 66 KB single-page-application HTML shell, not an OpenAPI document.
blockers: HTTP 403 AWS API Gateway 'Missing Authentication Token' on /search, with and without a dummy X-API-KEY, so it is not a shared static key.
HTTP 200 with a 2-byte {} body on /retrieve/<ct-number>: a success status carrying no record. This is exactly the shape a naive connector would log as 'found'.
No OpenAPI document at /api-docs (the SPA shell is returned).
